// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)

| where (FileName in~ ("transcript.pdf.js", "regsvcs.exe", "installutil.exe", "msbuild.exe", "aspnet_compiler.exe"))

          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,

2502.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — VEIL#DROP Malware Chain Uses Blogger Platform to Deliver PureLogs Stealer ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("transcript.pdf.js","regsvcs.exe","installutil.exe","msbuild.exe","aspnet_compiler.exe"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count

      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("transcript.pdf.js","regsvcs.exe","installutil.exe","msbuild.exe","aspnet_compiler.exe"))

       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name

description: Detects the ScreenConnect/AsyncRAT campaign defense-evasion script that adds Defender exclusions for RegAsm.exe and C:\Users\Public and sets ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin to 0.
references:
  - https://securelist.com/tr/the-soc-files-screenconnect-campaign-with-asyncrat/120472/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/01
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.t1548.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_ps:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_behaviour:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ExclusionProcess'
      - 'ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin'
      - 'Fj5NmEsp9EuKrun'
  selection_target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'RegAsm.exe'
      - 'C:\Users\Public'
  condition: selection_ps and (selection_behaviour or (selection_behaviour and selection_target))
level: high
2521.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") (Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath*" OR Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*" OR Processes.process="*ExclusionProcess*RegAsm.exe*" OR Processes.process="*ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin*" OR Processes.process="*Fj5NmEsp9EuKrun*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
2521.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*Add-MpPreference* OR *ExclusionProcess* OR *ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin* OR *Fj5NmEsp9EuKrun*)
2521.falcon: #event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i | regex("(Add-MpPreference|ExclusionProcess|ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin|Fj5NmEsp9EuKrun|RegAsm\.exe)", field=CommandLine) | groupBy([aid, ComputerName, CommandLine], function=count())

description: Detects an AI coding agent spawning a shell whose command line uses GuardFall-style obfuscation (empty-quote split binaries, base64 piped to shell, destructive find/dd flags) to bypass plain-text command blocklists.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/06/guardfall-exposes-open-source-ai-coding.html
  - https://adversa.ai/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/30
tags:
  - attack.t1027.010
  - attack.t1140
  - attack.t1059.004
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '/aider'
      - '/goose'
      - '/cline'
      - '/plandex'
      - '/opencode'
      - '/open-interpreter'
      - '/openhands'
      - '/swe-agent'
      - '/node'
      - '/python'
      - '/python3'
  selection_shell:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/bash'
      - '/sh'
      - '/dash'
      - '/zsh'
  selection_obfusc:
    CommandLine|re: "(?i)([a-z])'{2,}[a-z]|base64\\s+-d.*\\|\\s*(ba)?sh|\\bdd\\s+.+of=/dev/|find\\s+.+-delete|find\\s+.+-exec\\s+rm"
  condition: selection_parent and selection_shell and selection_obfusc
level: high
2564.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("aider","goose","cline","plandex","opencode","open-interpreter","openhands","swe-agent","roo-code","node","python","python3") Processes.process_name IN ("bash","sh","dash","zsh") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process, "(?i)([a-z])'{2,}[a-z]|base64\s+-d.*\|\s*(ba)?sh|\bdd\s+.+of=/dev/|find\s+.+-delete|find\s+.+-exec\s+rm") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
2564.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:EXECVE (@process.name:(bash OR sh OR dash OR zsh)) (@process.command_line:(*"base64 -d"* OR *"-exec rm"* OR *-delete* OR *of=/dev/*))
2564.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(aider|goose|cline|plandex|opencode|open-interpreter|openhands|swe-agent|node|python3?)$/i
| ImageFileName=/\/(bash|sh|dash|zsh)$/i
| regex("(?i)([a-z])'{2,}[a-z]|base64\s+-d.*\|\s*(ba)?sh|\bdd\s+.+of=/dev/|find\s+.+-delete|find\s+.+-exec\s+rm", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())

2565.def:

| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("aider","goose","cline","plandex","opencode","open-interpreter","openhands","swe-agent","interpreter")
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("--auto-exec","--auto-run","--auto-test","--yes-always","--no-confirm","dangerously-skip-permissions")
| where FileName in~ ("bash","sh","dash","zsh","python","python3")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256

2565.sent:
ImProcessCreate

| where ParentProcessName has_any ("aider","goose","cline","plandex","opencode","open-interpreter","openhands","swe-agent","interpreter")
| where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any ("--auto-exec","--auto-run","--auto-test","--yes-always","--no-confirm","dangerously-skip-permissions")

    objectRef.resource:
      - 'providers'
      - 'configurations'
      - 'functions'
